annotations.title: Solana Anchor & Rust Cross-Program Invocation (CPI) Vulnerability Scanner

description: Scans Solana Anchor and native Rust program instructions for unverified Cross-Program Invocation (CPI) program IDs, missing signer checks, and PDA bump seed canonicalization bugs. Use when auditing Solana Rust/Anchor source code or instruction account structs for CPI privilege escalation; for checking live SPL token mint/freeze authorities and rug-pull risk by mint address, use evaluate_solana_token_risk instead. Read-only edge call (32 KB, 60 RPM): accepts 'rust_source_or_idl' ('framework' defaults to 'anchor'), uses '?demo=true' or L402 (30 sats); HTTP 400 if invalid.

framework.description: Solana program framework used; defaults to 'anchor' when omitted.

rust_source_or_idl.description: Solana Rust/Anchor source code or IDL JSON string to scan for CPI vulnerabilities.

name: scan_solana_cpi_reentrancy

arbitrary_cpi_detected.description: True if invoke/invoke_signed is called without validating the target program account.

missing_signer_checks.description: Accounts mutated without enforcing Signer<'info> or has_one constraints.

pda_bump_safe.description: True when canonical bump seeds are enforced on all PDA derivations.

title: Solana Anchor & Rust Cross-Program Invocation (CPI) Vulnerability Scanner
